post.description: Ingress mTLS/service identity AND HMAC-SHA256 required. Sign UTF-8 timestamp + newline + event ID + newline + exact raw body bytes; lowercase hex digest, constant-time comparison. Reject timestamps outside +/-300 seconds (including future), invalid signature 401, untrusted service 403. Header/body eventId must match. Dedup by verified service/run/event ID plus raw-body hash; changed payload 409. Tenant resolved from authorized extraction run; check expected claim version and referenced evidence. Duplicate in replay window returns durable original acknowledgement; expired signed replay rejected 401 even if previously seen. Key rotation/identity trust deployment blocked until approved.

IdempotencyKey.description: Durable scope: verified tenant/membership + actor + operation + key; >=24h retention. Same payload replays original; mismatch/in-progress 409. Never log secrets.

MembershipContext.name: X-Membership-Context
MembershipContext.description: Opaque server-issued context from membership selection. Verify binding to current principal, active grant and expiry; never accept tenant IDs.

Error404.description: Missing or inaccessible object; conceal cross-tenant existence

Error409.description: Stale version, idempotency mismatch or in-progress operation

Retry-After.description: Seconds before retry when retryable; omit for payload/stale conflicts

Money.description: VND NUMERIC(15,2); Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP for computation; never JSON number.

Membership.description: Server-issued active grant; roles alone do not grant object access. No client tenant assertion.

MembershipSelection.description: Select an existing grant; server revalidates active membership on every request.

MembershipContext.description: Opaque server-bound context, never a tenant ID. Revoke on membership change.

ZaloExchange.description: Technical adapter proposal only; blocked until provider-supported code/PKCE/state semantics are verified. No client userId/tenantId accepted.

AuthSession.description: No local identity/password server. Issuer/audience/algorithms/JWKS/MFA mapping require approved OIDC provider configuration.

ConsentRequest.description: Server verifies subject/guardian, approved purpose and exact presented policy; records server time and evidence. Client boolean alone is insufficient.

ECard.description: Opaque short-lived token, maximum 60 seconds; no raw CCCD/phone/bank data. Backend authorization required on redemption; coverage is not benefit approval.

UploadRequest.description: 20 MiB technical maximum; deploy policy may be stricter. Bind immutable object key, verified subject/membership/member and checksum. No arbitrary object key accepted.

UploadGrant.description: Expires in at most 300 seconds. Private bucket; URL/header secrets must never enter logs/events/history; checksum header is base64 SHA-256.

UploadComplete.description: Server independently HEAD/checks owner, immutable key/version, actual size/checksum and sniffed type. Mismatch 422; expired session 409; no fetch of caller URLs.

Document.description: Original immutable, inaccessible to AI/preflight/claim attachment until CLEAN. Reject malware, polyglots, decompression bombs; no storage keys or PII in response.

PreflightRequest.description: Only CLEAN documents owned by same subject/member/membership. Does not approve benefits or reserve money.

Warning.description: Warnings require versioned verified policy evidence; examples are not universal legal exclusions.

ClaimSubmit.description: Server verifies ownership, CLEAN docs, current consent/purpose/policy, preflight version and coverage. No raw storage keys. Post-commit only: business state + audit hash chain + outbox in withTenantTransaction using SET LOCAL/RLS.

ClaimDetail.description: Owner/verified guardian or explicitly assigned staff only; detail reads PostgreSQL, not search. No cross-tenant existence disclosure.

ClaimSupplement.description: Only SUPPLEMENT_REQUIRED before deadline; server checks status, CLEAN owner/member docs and aggregate version under lock. Atomic audit/outbox; duplicate command has no repeated transition.

Evidence.description: Normalized page region; confidence is not money. Evidence resolves authorized immutable original, never an arbitrary URL.

TaxVerification.description: Parsing QR/XML never implies VERIFIED_VALID. Verified outcomes require independently authenticated source evidence; provider semantics remain blocked pending sandbox verification.

ExtractedLine.description: AI proposal only; no approved/rejected amount or contract decision. PII-redacted item text; core recomputes monetary consistency with Decimal.

FraudSignal.description: Signal for review, never sufficient to deny coverage.

AiResult.description: Service identity maps run to tenant/claim; no caller tenant. Core verifies run, document ownership/version, evidence references and stale version. No raw XML/OCR/PII, URLs, benefit decisions. Never log body. Invoice is omitted if not extracted; failure/unavailable source status must not become VERIFIED_VALID.

AiAcknowledgement.description: 200 only after durable inbox/dedup+result+audit+outbox commit. Same eventId/different raw body hash 409; valid identical replay returns DUPLICATE without side effects.

ExtractedInvoice.description: Redacted extraction proposal, not verified tax evidence; excludes raw buyer name/address/identity. Seller identifier must be authorized for service processing; never log payload.
